annotations.text:
Enquiry + 7-day date hold, not instant booking.

Desktop flow is clickable: pick a date (Saturdays 7 and 21 Nov are taken, 14 is on hold), step through package, details and the hold review. The summary panel re-prices as you go — weekdays carry a 15% venue reduction.

All rand figures are sample values. Real facts left bracketed: [VENUE PHONE].
Confirmation screen after the hold is requested. Deliberately not a receipt — no payment has happened. It sells the next step: read the proposal, walk the farm, then 25% to confirm.
